description: HR-19 is the Registering and Licensing Authority (RLA) code for Charkhi Dadri, operating under the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM). The office primarily handles the registration of private (non-transport) vehicles and the issuance of learner and permanent driving licenses for the residents of the sub-division.
address: Office of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate, Mini Secretariat, Charkhi Dadri, Haryana
